title: Docs: PROJECT.md says fallback only on classified rate limits; adj 156 supersedes

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S49 relay later note. PROJECT.md:145 still says fallback only on classified rate limits; adj 156 (vendor.fallback-trigger-v2) supersedes adj 114 and falls back on a rate-limited or error exit. Also grep the docs for the old wording.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `PROJECT.md:145`: say fallback is on a rate-limited or error exit; auth, denials and unclassified exits stop (adj 156).
- Any other doc that rg finds with the old wording (rg -n "classified rate limit|rate limit only" PROJECT.md docs).

sections.heading: Implement
